scope: Independent bounded CPU source/test/specification review and full actual-candidate replay; not pretrained reasoning or serving performance.

replay.excluded_comparison_keys: Only keys ending in seconds, recursively within runs; top-level environment/memory/provenance fields were not compared.

fresh_notebook.boundary: Final agent fresh kernel; root inspected source/spec/tests and selected error-correlation/held-out figures. All five previews separately inspected by builder.

retained_negative_controls: Wrong majority despite a correct answer in the pool
Longest selector has no eligible length contrast
Whole-attempt overshoot charged but not selectable
authorization_boundary: No Git commit/push, external service, shared-environment changes, model acquisition, Spark GPU or Mac execution.
